notes:
DOMAIN: westwing.co.uk (Westwing UK storefront specifically) - not westwing.de (SR 103) or westwing.it (SR 121). All 62 links below are on www.westwing.co.uk and every qty was read from the UK site's own GBP-priced pages.

ACCESS: plain direct fetch via probe.py throughout; no proxy, impersonation, jina or translate.goog needed, matching the prior Home-Decor pass (notes/91.md). robots.txt does name ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/anthropic-ai, but they sit in one combined AI-crawler group whose Disallow list (/all-products, /p/s/*, /customer*, /sso/*, /c/*, /products/*, /collections/*, /api/*) is byte-identical to the generic 'User-agent: *' block plus an extra 'Allow: /llms.txt' - it is not more restrictive for Claude than for anyone else, and none of those path prefixes match this site's category URL pattern (flat slugs off the root, e.g. /sofas/, /dining-tables/). Same finding as the Westwing IT pass. Proceeded.

TREE SOURCE: the real mega-menu, not a guess. The storefront is a Shopify Oxygen/Hydrogen React-Router app; the full navigation is embedded in the homepage as a flattened turbo-stream payload (window.__reactRouterContext.streamController.enqueue). I decoded that 5536-entry array and resolved it back into the complete 3-level menu (w91_navtree.txt, 520 lines, all 16 top-level departments). Cross-checked against /sitemap-categories.xml (550 URLs) to catch category listings that exist but are not linked from the nav - that surfaced Sofa Elements (251) and Floor Cushions & Pouffes (15), both included and flagged, and Plant Shelves / Hammocks & Hanging Chairs / Bed Series Sato, all rejected (see below).

DEPTH: I verified these are true leaves. Every category page carries an identical 501-slug navigation payload and zero page-specific subcategory links, so there is no fourth level below the mega-nav leaves - the nav is the whole tree.

QTY METHOD: rendered listing header only (method 1). Each page prints 'N products' in its sort/filter bar and, independently, 'X of N products are displayed' in its load-more footer; both were extracted from the same fetch and had to match exactly or the row would have been nulled. All 62 leaves passed that double-match. I deliberately did NOT use the page's JSON-LD 'numberOfItems', which is 30 on every page (the SSR first batch, not the total), and did not count tiles. Sanity checks run: (a) counts vary per category (9 to 413) - no constant site-wide number; (b) no suspiciously round display caps; (c) the h1 of every fetched page matches the category requested; (d) drift re-read: 9 leaves (Corner Sofas, Side Tables, Wall Shelves, Shoe Storage, Garden Chairs, Kids Tables & Chairs, Sofa Elements, Pouffes, Desks) were fetched a second time later in the session - all 9 returned identical numbers, 0 drift; (e) no parent count was ever copied down or child counts summed up.

DEDUPE (the main hazard on this site): Westwing repeats the same node under several departments using -2/-3 suffixed slugs (e.g. Furniture > Chairs > Garden chairs = /garden-chairs-2/ while Outdoor > Garden furniture > Garden chairs = /garden-chairs/). These are NOT always equal populations - /garden-chairs/ is 78 but /garden-chairs-2/ is 54, /garden-side-tables/ is 55 vs 23, /coffee-tables/ 295 vs /coffee-tables-3/ 9 - so they are filtered re-cuts, not mirrors. The site resolves this itself: all 11 suffixed aliases I fetched (bedside-tables-2, shoe-cupboards-shoe-racks-2, shoe-cupboards-shoe-racks-3, open-wardrobes-2, garden-chairs-2, garden-tables-2, garden-side-tables-2, garden-armchairs-2, coffee-tables-3, benches-2, beds-with-storage-2) carry NO rel=canonical tag and no ItemList JSON-LD, while every unsuffixed slug is self-canonical. I dropped all 11 aliases and kept only self-canonical URLs, so no product-type appears twice. Also dropped /poufs-1/ (65) as a duplicate of /pouffes/ (65): identical total and 30/30 identical sampled product URLs; /pouffes/ is the one in the nav. Dropped /pouffes-with-storage/ (20) as a storage-feature re-cut of Pouffes - 18 of its 20 products (90%) are already in the /pouffes/ sample. Dropped /outdoor-storage/ (2) as a duplicate of /garden-storage/ (2), same 2 products (and both excluded anyway, see below).

EXCLUDED and why: Mirrors (Furniture > Mirrors /mirrors-2/ and all its children) - Wall Decor's job, not furniture. Sofa cushions, all Textiles/Rugs/Bedding - textiles. Sofa Series /collection/sofa-collection/ and Bed Series /collection/bed-collection/ and /bed-series-sato/ - marketing collection landing pages, banned by rule 3. Coat hooks & rails (163) - sampled tiles are wall hooks, key boxes and clothes rails, i.e. hardware, not furniture. Office storage (107) - sampled tiles are magazine files, document folders, desk organisers and pinboards, i.e. standalone storage/office supplies. Storage > Small storage & organisers and its whole subtree (baskets, laundry baskets, storage boxes, jewellery boxes, bins, kitchen storage, bathroom accessories) - standalone storage goods, reserved for the Storage task. Garden storage (2) / Outdoor storage (2) - both are the same 'Cushion Box Atlantic with Wheels', a storage box, not furniture. Baby bouncers (12) - filed by the site under Kids furniture but the tiles are baby bouncers and bouncer toys, i.e. baby equipment, which contradicts the site's classification. Storage > Furniture with storage function (223) - a feature re-cut whose children are all re-cuts of nodes already recorded (Beds with storage, Benches, Coffee tables, Pouffes). All Lighting, Tableware, Kitchen, Kids textiles/toys/decoration, Gifts, Deals, Brands and the 'Shop by room' department (which is entirely -N-suffixed aliases of nodes already recorded).

EMPTY NODES rejected as non-functioning rather than real categories (each confirmed by the page's own '0 products' header and '0 of 0 products are displayed' footer): Bean bags & floor cushions /bean-bags-floor-cushions/ (0), Plant shelves /plant-shelves/ (0), Hammocks & hanging chairs /hammocks-hanging-chairs/ (0).

PARENT DEPARTMENT TOTALS observed but not recorded as rows, since parents with extractable children are grouping rows: Furniture 5297, Sofas 1239, Tables 1208, Shelves 647, Cabinets 615, Wardrobes 335, Chairs 337, Armchairs 252, Beds 189, Kids furniture 194, Garden furniture 266, Stools & pouffes 147, Racks & stands 299, Outdoor 905, Storage 2448.
